_comment: Example config for the Salesforce-HOSTED Data 360 MCP server (data-360-mcp). Cursor form shown: add via Settings > MCP > New MCP Server, then paste this into mcp.json. 'url' = the server URL copied from Setup (sandbox path shown; drop 'sandbox/' for production). 'auth.CLIENT_ID' = the External Client App Consumer Key. Auth is per-user OAuth 2.0 + PKCE handled interactively — NO client secret lives here. For Claude Code use the `claude mcp add --transport http ...` command in 03-connect-claude.md instead. See setup/02-auth-setup.md.
